description: Defines type traits and utility templates for type introspection, such as checking equality comparability, hashability, function types, template instantiations, functors, lambdas, and type conditions within the 'c10::guts' namespace.

classes.name: is_equality_comparable
classes.description: Type trait to check if '==' operator is defined for type T.

classes.name: is_hashable
classes.description: Type trait to check if std::hash is defined for type T.

classes.name: is_function_type
classes.description: Type trait to check if T is a plain function type.

classes.name: is_instantiation_of
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type T is an instantiation of a template.

classes.name: is_functor
classes.description: Type trait to check if a class has a call operator (functor).

classes.name: is_stateless_lambda
classes.description: Type trait to check if a lambda is stateless (no closure).

classes.name: is_type_condition
classes.description: Type trait to check if a template class is a type trait with a static bool '::value'.

classes.name: is_fundamental
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type T is a fundamental type.

methods.name: std::declval
methods.description: Utility to declare a value of a given type for unevaluated contexts.

methods.name: std::is_same_v
methods.description: Type trait to check if two types are the same.

methods.name: std::is_convertible
methods.description: Type trait to check if one type is convertible to another.

methods.name: std::remove_cv_t
methods.description: Type trait to remove const and volatile qualifiers.

methods.name: decltype
methods.description: Operator to query the type of an expression.
